releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.8 — Network Jitter Fix & OmniMotion FrameGen Architecture:
- Zero-Jitter Network Engine: Fixed network lag by resetting NetworkThrottlingIndex to Windows Gaming QoS default (10), optimizing TcpAckFrequency/TCPNoDelay for low ping, and flushing DNS cache.
- OmniMotion AI Native FrameGen: In-house 2X/3X frame generator built from scratch using QPC cadence tracking and DWM presentation queues.
- Force DLSS 3 & Force Lossless Scaling: Hardware Ada Optical Flow override and universal LSFG auto-hook.
- Dynamic Selected Mode Lighting.
